Descriptions below. And basic probability explanations, for those who care.
**Mushroom**; adds +5 to your roll. Costs 3 coins. Or 1 coin at the One-coin shop in Rainbow Galleria
-> possible rolls; 6 to 15 (i.e. 1+5 to 10+5)
With a Mushroom you are guaranteed to go at least 6 spaces. You have a 50% chance that you'll travel more than 10 spaces with a Mushroom (i.e. 11 or more spaces). This is because you have a 50/50 chance of rolling a 6-10 (but also the same chance of rolling lower).
**Double Dice**; adds another die. Costs 5 coins.
-> possible rolls; 2 to 20.
However with the way 2 dice probability works, your most probable roll will be 11; then 10 or 12; then 9 or 13; and so forth.
Why 11? Because it has the most possible combinations on the two 10-dice blocks; 1+10, 2+9, 3+8, 4+7, 5+6, 6+5, 7+4, 8+3, 9+2, and 10+1. Then the numbers closest to 11 go next, and so forth.
This is very similar to how in Monopoly, which uses 2 6ds, your most likely roll is 7; which is why Orange properties in that game are really useful as most players are likely to land on them.
Also with double dice, if you roll doubles (e.g. 5 + 5) you get 10 coins. However you have a 1in10 chance altogether (10%) of rolling doubles.
Which item do you prefer most of the time? Mushroom or double dice?
Do not collect junk in your hearts. You can make yourself happy if you don't let others make you unhappy.

**Cozy****(Topic Creator)4 months ago#2
Personally, I will buy a Mushroom in the early turns (first 2) when I feel consistency is better.
Though that said, Double Dice are better afterwards. As you start gaining a lot more items, it's worth to just go for them instead after that, as recovering from possible bad rolls becomes easier the following turns.
It's a bit close but overall I feel Double Dice are better and worth the risk. Most of the time anyways.

GLACIER FTW

**Happydudey****3 months ago#4
Depends on what's needed in the moment.
If the roll needed is within 6-10 I'm choosing the mushroom since it's more of a sure thing.
If I need to roll somewhere between 13-15, I'm likely going double dice even though it technically can be achieved with a mushroom.
|
**ShyRanger****3 months ago#5
Mushroom - I've had so many instances where I needed just a 6, and when I rolled the Double Dice I got lower numbers.
|
**Cozy****(Topic Creator)2 months ago#6
I will agree that consistency wise, mushrooms are better. For me, the cutoff is about 8 spaces with mushrooms. Chances of getting a 3 (+5=8) or higher are pretty good on a 10-sided dice.
But if I want to go more than 8 spaces, again as stated 11 is the most likely combination with double dice. And you get them all the time in Pro Rules with lucky spaces.
So yeah, it does depend on the situation I suppose.
Do not collect junk in your hearts. You can make yourself happy if you don't let others make you unhappy.
- Fredrik Backman, "The Answer is No" p57

**TraineeShanna****2 months ago#7
Double Dice are usually a little bit better, so in most cases they're preferable. Occasionally the Mushroom is better in the case of "I absolutely need a 6+", doubles will rarely fail that, but they can.
Rolf's Bow is funny in that its name tells you the problem - it's a bow, and it belongs to Rolf. It would be fine if those things were not true.
-Panthera
